label: Hot water cylinder (heated by gas boiler)
description: Hot water cylinder whose heat input is supplied by a gas boiler. Computes gas input and annual tCO2e from delivered hot water heat.

inputs.label: Annual hot water heat delivered
inputs.help: Thermal energy delivered as hot water over a year (kWh thermal).

inputs.label: Boiler efficiency
inputs.help: Fraction (0–1). Used to convert delivered heat to gas input energy.

inputs.label: Gas carbon intensity
inputs.help: Override if you have a better factor for your region/supplier.
